title: One Checkpoint, Many Runs: Recipe Cards for Fine-Tuned Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16825v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fine-tuned language models are shared with model cards that describe the training setup in detail, often down to the default random seed, but report the score of a single released checkpoint. Such setups are retrained routinely, by fine-tuning services for each customer, by organizations at each update, and by users on their own data, so the model that is deployed comes from a new run of the setup. Some runs fail, and a failed run can go unnoticed and reach the people the model serves. We call such a setup a model recipe and argue that its documentation should state how often a run of the recipe misses a required performance bar. In a survey of the model cards of 300 fine-tuned language models on Hugging Face, none reports this failure probability, and only three report results from more than one training run. translated_title: 一个检查点，多次运行：微调模型的“配方卡”
translated_abstract: 微调后的语言模型通常附带模型卡共享，模型卡对训练设置的描述十分详尽，甚至细化到默认随机种子，但只报告单一已发布检查点的分数。这类设置经常被重复训练：微调服务为每个客户重新训练，机构在每次更新时重新训练，用户也会在自己的数据上重新训练，因此实际部署的模型来自该设置的一次全新运行。有些运行会失败，而失败的运行可能未被察觉，并最终交付到模型所服务的用户手中。我们将这样的设置称为“模型配方”，并主张其文档应当说明该配方的一次运行有多大概率达不到所需的性能门槛。在对 Hugging Face 上 300 个微调语言模型的模型卡进行的调查中，没有任何一张报告了这种失败概率，仅有三张报告了不止一次训练运行的结果。在 2,124 次微调运行中，我们发现将均值、中位数或 bootstrap 区间解读为验收标准时，往往会让实际未达标的运行通过验收。
tldr: 论文提出“模型配方”概念，主张模型卡应披露一次运行达不到性能门槛的失败概率，并通过对 300 张模型卡的调查和 2,124 次微调运行证明，仅以均值、中位数或 bootstrap 区间作为验收标准常常会误判通过失败的运行。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the notion of "model recipes," arguing that model cards should report the probability that a run misses the required performance bar, and shows across 300 model cards and 2,124 fine-tuning runs that approving based on the mean, median, or a bootstrap interval often lets failed runs pass.
